push.title: W 3-2 vs fifa ballers | You: 9.3 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.3. That's not a performance, that's a postcard from the top of the mountain.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at fifa ballers's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.
+ Man of the Match, your 10th for us. Frame it, then hang it where your mama can see it.
+ You and BellyTb1 were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.
+ Your best match performance of the season (9.3). Keep stacking those.

THE BAD
- Lowest shots on the team: 3 (best was BellyTb1's 5). Here's how: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- 1 tackle won took 0.1 away. Fixable.
- Pass accuracy: 82%. One gear up gets you to 88%+.

Practice pointer: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

buddskees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Couldn't have asked for more. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.9 against fifa ballers: your 2nd best match performance of the season. Let's make that a habit.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at fifa ballers's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ You and buddskees turned simple passes into goals.
+ Your 2nd best match performance of the season, at 7.9. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Tackle success 40%, up from your usual 24%. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (17 vs their best 14). Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- 1 of 5 shots on target. Homework: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 63% passing (17 of 27, down from your usual 76%). Old coach's advice: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Trust the work.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was buddskees's 0). Back to basics: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Key passes: 1. Top-quarter forwards live at 2+. Let's move in.

Daily reps: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs fifa ballers | You: 7.4 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.4 against fifa ballers, your 2nd best match performance of the season. Solid as a church pew.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at fifa ballers's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ Your 2nd best match performance of the season at 7.4. Do it again.
+ Giveaways 3, down from your usual 8. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Snapped a 7-match losing run. That's a team that believes in itself.

THE BAD
- On-ball actions 21, down from your usual 38. That's where the match slipped.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Keep this in your pocket: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Think about this: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- 0.5 off your norm. Let it go like a bad haircut. It'll grow back.
- Shots on target: 75%. Solid, but the best forwards hit 90%+.

Coach's drill: Drop between the lines to link play, then spin in behind once it goes wide.

One thought for the road, PhogsToffees: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Keep the faith, partner. - Coach Lasso
